title: asset.approved payload
description: Emitted by MAM when an asset is approved for air. Consumed by Scheduling, Integration, Logging.

expiresAt.description: When the media becomes unusable and requires re-review. Absent = permanent approval. Defaults from the asset's category (FR-TAX-7), overridable per asset.

reviewPointId.description: Optional id of the workflow review step that produced this verdict (FR-APP-5).
